programme.desc: Un sheriff retirado de los Rangers de Texas debe volver a las armas cuando una peligrosa banda de moteros toma su pequeño pueblo y amenaza con sembrar el caos y la violencia.

programme.title: Día de redención
programme.desc: Un exmarine inicia una peligrosa misión en Marruecos para rescatar a su esposa, secuestrada por un grupo terrorista que amenaza con provocar un conflicto internacional.

programme.title: Kill'em All
programme.desc: Tras un grave tiroteo, un misterioso extraño (Van Damme) llega al hospital al borde de la muerte. De repente, una banda extranjera entra para darle caza.

programme.title: Espacio/Tiempo
programme.desc: En un futuro al borde del colapso, unos científicos desarrollan una turbina para realizar viajes interestelares que podría salvar a la humanidad. Cuando les cortan la financiación por un fatal accidente, deciden recurrir a actividades delictivas para reconstruir su máquina.

programme.title: La superviviente
programme.desc: Desesperada por salvar a su hermana, una geóloga acepta un peligroso trabajo en la remota naturaleza salvaje de Georgia. Después de un accidente de helicóptero que la deja varada en las montañas, encuentra esperanza a través de un hombre que la ayuda por radio.

programme.title: Bajo amenaza
programme.desc: El afamado realizador Joel Schumacher dirige a Nicolas Cage y Nicole Kidman en este thriller con gran ritmo y guión. Una pareja son brutalmente asaltados en su casa por un grupo de criminales que los toma como rehenes. La situación se irá complicando a medida que se descubren traiciones y engaños.

programme.title: Alta Mar
programme.desc: Tres parejas celebran un cumpleaños en un yate para pasar un lujoso fin de semana. Tras la noche todo parece en calma, pero nada más lejos de la realidad. Su pesadilla acaba de empezar.

programme.title: Volvemos pronto con más contenido
programme.desc: ¡Estamos recuperando el sueño perdido! Permanece atento a la magnífica selección de entretenimiento de Rakuten TV.

programme.title: La sombra del pasado
programme.desc: Kurt es un joven estudiante de arte en la Alemania del Este, enamorado de su compañera de clase, Ellie. El padre de ella, no aprueba la relación de su hija y está decidido a destruirla. Ninguno de ellos sabe es que sus vidas están conectadas por un terrible crimen cometido hace décadas.

programme.title: Nekrotronic
programme.desc: Finnegan, la mejor de los cazadores de demonios conocidos como Nikromantes, fue la primera en descubrir espíritus malignos dentro de internet y la primera en introducir su alma en la web para llevar la mítica batalla entre el bien y el mal al reino digital.

programme.title: Freaked. La disparatada parada de los monstruos
programme.desc: Ricky, contratado por una empresa para patrocinar un componente químico, descubre que la molécula es responsable de monstruosas deformidades. Comedia loca con súper reparto y estatus de culto.

programme.title: At First Light
programme.desc: La joven Alex Lainey tiene un encuentro con misteriosas luces que aparecen sobre su pequeño pueblo. Rápidamente desarrolla habilidades sobrenaturales pero extremadamente peligrosas...

programme.title: Space Battleship Yamato
programme.desc: En 2199, la Tierra agoniza por la radiación de los Gamilas. Tras recibir un mensaje de esperanza desde el planeta Iskandar, la humanidad reconstruye el acorazado Yamato. Susumu Kodai lidera una misión de 150.000 años luz para salvar al mundo de la extinción.

programme.title: 60 Minutes
programme.desc: The oldest and most-watched newsmagazine on television gets the real story on America's most prevalent issues. CBS News correspondents contribute segments to each hourlong episode. Topics range from hard news coverage to politics, lifestyle, pop culture, business, health, and science. The correspondents and contributors include Lesley Stahl, Scott Pelley, Anderson Cooper, Bill Whitaker, Sharyn Alfonsi, Jon Wertheim and Norah O'Donnell .

programme.title: Episode 1
programme.desc: Journalist Adriana Diaz anchors the Saturday edition of the CBS news program from Chicago, while Jericka Duncan takes the helm of the Sunday broadcast from New York. The program offers the latest headlines, original reporting and in-depth pieces that add context and perspective to the world's events.

programme.title: Everybody Loves Sunshine
programme.desc: In Manchester's Pepperhill Estate, cousins and gang leaders Ray (Andrew Goth) and Terry (Goldie) have always relied on each other. Ray, tired of gang life and in love with Clare (Rachel Shelley), wants out. But Terry, obsessed with keeping Ray in the gang, won't let him leave. While they're in prison, the Chinese Triad kills a gang member. As revenge looms, aging gangster Bernie (David Bowie) struggles to maintain peace.

programme.title: Meek's Cutoff
programme.desc: Settlers traveling through the Oregon desert in 1845 find themselves stranded in harsh conditions.

programme.title: We Need to Talk About Kevin
programme.desc: Eva is mother to the evil Kevin. She contends with her clueless husband and her son's malevolent ways, in this chilling and unforgettable film.

programme.title: Shark Girl
programme.desc: When a beautiful young influencer survives a mysterious shark attack, she becomes a monstrous apex predator, hunting and feeding in sunny Venice beach, California.

programme.title: Monsters
programme.desc: After Earth has suffered an alien invasion a journalist escort an American tourist through an infected zone.

programme.title: Chronicles of the Ghostly Tribe
programme.desc: A soldier is working in a snowcapped mountain when an explosion reveals bizarre fossils hidden deep in the caverns. What they discover next will change human history forever.

programme.title: Kiss Of The Damned
programme.desc: A blossoming romance between a vampire and a human is endangered by an unexpected visit.

programme.title: Lake Alice
programme.desc: The Thomases visit their family cabin to celebrate Christmas with their daughter and her boyfriend, but their first holiday together may be their last.

programme.title: Wraith
programme.desc: After living in an old mansion for almost 10 years a family suddenly discovers a ghost-like presence trying to communicate with them.

programme.title: The Golem
programme.desc: A mystical woman must save her village from invaders, but the entity she conjures to protect them is a far greater evil.

programme.title: Let The Right One In
programme.desc: Oskar, an overlooked and bullied boy, finds love and revenge through Eli, a beautiful but peculiar girl.

programme.title: Mermaid Down
programme.desc: A mermaid is ripped from the Pacific, her tail is chopped off and she's thrown into a mental home where no one believes she is a mermaid.

programme.title: Vanishing on 7th Street
programme.desc: A blackout causes a city's population to vanish. A handful of survivors realize they escape the darkness.

programme.title: Book of Monsters
programme.desc: Sophie's 18th birthday becomes a bloodbath when monsters descend upon her house and start to devour the party guests.

programme.title: Uncaged
programme.desc: After finding a gruesomely slaughtered family just outside Amsterdam, the police calls veterinarian Lizzy for help. She finds herself leading the city-wide hunt for a monstrous lion terrorizing the Dutch capital in this grisly adventure.

programme.title: SPLINTER
programme.desc: Trapped in a gas station by a parasite, a couple and an escaped convict must find a way to survive.

programme.title: Mermaid Down
programme.desc: A mermaid is ripped from the Pacific, her tail is chopped off and she's thrown into a mental home where no one believes she is a mermaid.

programme.title: Marrowbone
programme.desc: A ghostly presence and a lawyer come between four young siblings. They must stand together or be torn apart.

programme.title: The Woman in the Fifth
programme.desc: A college lecturer flees to Paris after a scandal costs him his job. In the City of Light, he meets a widow who might be involved in a series of murders.

programme.title: Violet & Daisy
programme.desc: Two teenage assassins accept what they think will be a quick-and-easy job, until an unexpected target throws them off their plan.

programme.title: Vanishing on 7th Street
programme.desc: A blackout causes a city's population to vanish. A handful of survivors realize they escape the darkness.

programme.title: Robot Overlords
programme.desc: Earth has been conquered by robots from a distant galaxy. Survivors are confined to their houses and must wear electronic implants, risking incineration by robot sentries if they venture outside.

programme.title: The Endless
programme.desc: Acclaimed filmmakers Moorhead and Benson return with this mind-bending thriller that follows two brothers who receive a cryptic video message inspiring them to revisit the UFO death cult they escaped a decade earlier.

programme.title: We Have Always Lived in the Castle
programme.desc: Two sisters live in isolation with their deranged uncle following the deaths of the rest of their family. When a cousin comes to visit, family secrets and scandals unravel. Based on the beloved Shirley Jackson novel.

programme.title: Night Moves
programme.desc: Three radical environmentalists look to execute the protest of their lives: the explosion of a hydroelectric dam.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Allyn Joslyn guest-stars as Sam Hilliard, a former truant officer who now heads a private school where Wednesday and Pugsley are enrolled. When Hilliard breaks under the strain of dealing with the Addams children, Gomez buys the school.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Dr. Marvin P. Gunderson is summoned to examine Kitty Kat, the ailing lion pet of the Addams Family. Morticia decides that it is the doctor who needs help. To build his confidence, human members of the family pretend to be ill so he can affect cures.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's concern that Lurch is overworked leads Gomez to the operating table to assemble a custom-built secondary butler. Lurch lets the robot do all the work and then begins to feel that he isn't needed anymore.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company. Mr. Henson, the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business. The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler in to a new personality.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing. Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez decide to keep Wednesday and Pugsley home from school after Morticia sees the fairy tales they have to read. When the truant officer comes to investigate, he is shocked at what he finds.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia calls a psychiatrist after she fears Pugsley is becoming normal after he abandons his pet octopus for a puppy and is seen wearing a Boy Scout uniform, playing with a baseball bat, and helping an old lady cross the street.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs. Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where he is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's cousin, Melancholia, wants to marry Clarence P. Harvey after most of her marital prospects have joined the Foreign Legion. Clarence recoils when Melancholia puts on a campaign to win him, backed by Morticia, Gomez and Clarence's boss.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes a veritable gazelle when he takes dancing lessons at Gomez and Morticia's suggestion, after he admits to being a wallflower at social functions. Each member of the Addams Family teaches Lurch a different step.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract. The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Rockland Cartright III is a beatnik who crashes his motorbike into a tree and recuperates at the Addams house. Each regards the other as an oddity, although the family learns to appreciate certain aspects of Rockland's life.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Mr. Briggs, the postman, is hired by the government to do undercover work in the Addams house. While pretending to be a stamp collector, he investigates rumors that coded radio messages are being sent from the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she an Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up). Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Moriticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight, members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it, he will lose her.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets, a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney, to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter, Consuella. Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Wednesday's and Pugsley's faith in Santa Claus is shaken, Uncle Fester is chosen to back up Santa in case the real St. Nick is too busy to come. However, Fester-Santa gets stuck in the chimney, so each of the other adults fill in for him.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career. However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job. His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird. He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandma Frump (guest star Margaret Hamilton) comes to the mistaken conclusion that her daughter, Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and Gomez (John Astin) plan to pack her off to an old folks home. Actually, they plan to send her to a beauty farm.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's cousin, Melancholia, wants to marry Clarence P. Harvey after most of her marital prospects have joined the Foreign Legion. Clarence recoils when Melancholia puts on a campaign to win him, backed by Morticia, Gomez and Clarence's boss.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes a veritable gazelle when he takes dancing lessons at Gomez and Morticia's suggestion, after he admits to being a wallflower at social functions. Each member of the Addams Family teaches Lurch a different step.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract. The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Rockland Cartright III is a beatnik who crashes his motorbike into a tree and recuperates at the Addams house. Each regards the other as an oddity, although the family learns to appreciate certain aspects of Rockland's life.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Mr. Briggs, the postman, is hired by the government to do undercover work in the Addams house. While pretending to be a stamp collector, he investigates rumors that coded radio messages are being sent from the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she an Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up). Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Moriticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight, members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it, he will lose her.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets, a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney, to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter, Consuella. Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Wednesday's and Pugsley's faith in Santa Claus is shaken, Uncle Fester is chosen to back up Santa in case the real St. Nick is too busy to come. However, Fester-Santa gets stuck in the chimney, so each of the other adults fill in for him.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career. However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job. His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird. He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandma Frump (guest star Margaret Hamilton) comes to the mistaken conclusion that her daughter, Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and Gomez (John Astin) plan to pack her off to an old folks home. Actually, they plan to send her to a beauty farm.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Allyn Joslyn guest-stars as Sam Hilliard, a former truant officer who now heads a private school where Wednesday and Pugsley are enrolled. When Hilliard breaks under the strain of dealing with the Addams children, Gomez buys the school.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Dr. Marvin P. Gunderson is summoned to examine Kitty Kat, the ailing lion pet of the Addams Family. Morticia decides that it is the doctor who needs help. To build his confidence, human members of the family pretend to be ill so he can affect cures.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's concern that Lurch is overworked leads Gomez to the operating table to assemble a custom-built secondary butler. Lurch lets the robot do all the work and then begins to feel that he isn't needed anymore.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company. Mr. Henson, the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business. The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler in to a new personality.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing. Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez decide to keep Wednesday and Pugsley home from school after Morticia sees the fairy tales they have to read. When the truant officer comes to investigate, he is shocked at what he finds.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia calls a psychiatrist after she fears Pugsley is becoming normal after he abandons his pet octopus for a puppy and is seen wearing a Boy Scout uniform, playing with a baseball bat, and helping an old lady cross the street.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs. Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where he is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: Gershwin's Greatest Hits
programme.desc: Belgian conductor Jos van Immerseel leads Anima Eterna Brugge.

programme.title: A Tango Night: Live from Buenos Aires
programme.desc: The Orquesta Filarmónica del Teatro Colón under Daniel Barenboim performs live at an Argentinean music festival.

programme.title: Liszt's Concerto No. 1 & Mahler's Symphony No. 5
programme.desc: Michael Tilson Thomas conducts the London Symphony Orchestra in a performance of Mahler's Fifth Symphony; Lukáš Vondráček is the soloist in Liszt's First Piano Concerto.

programme.title: Fantasymphony: One Concert to Rule them all
programme.desc: Featuring film music hits from Oscar-winning movies such as "The Lord of the Rings," "Game of Thrones," "The Chronicles of Narnia" and "Harry Potter." Concert orchestration based on the original arrangements and instruments of the film scores.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Sinfonía por el Perú from Philharmonie de Paris
Tchaikovsky Symphony 2 & Elgar's Enigma Variations
programme.desc: The Maggio Musicale Fiorentino (Florence Musical May) is Italy's oldest opera and arts festival.

programme.title: Dvorák's Slavonic Dances, Op. 46
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle conducts the London Symphony Orchestra in Dvorák's Slavonic Dances, Op. 46 (Nos. 5-8); recorded at St. Luke's, London.

programme.title: Grieg's Piano Concerto & Beethoven Symphony No. 7
programme.desc: Conductor Jan Latham-Koenig leads the Flanders Symphony Orchestra in a concert recorded at Concertgebouw Brugge, Belgium; Felix Mendelssohn's concert overture Die Hebrides, Op. 26; Edvard Grieg's Piano Concerto in A minor, Op. 16.

programme.title: The Four Seasons
programme.desc: Things change for a middle-class couple (Alan Alda, Carol Burnett) and two other couples they vacation with four times a year.

programme.title: Sibelius, Mendelssohn & Saariaho
programme.desc: Stephanie Childress leads the LSO in a Northern European concert from LSO St Luke's, featuring works by Sibelius, Mendelssohn and Kaija Saariaho; the evening includes Sibelius's En Saga and Cassazione, Mendelssohn's Violin Concerto.

programme.title: Mahler, The Song of the Earth
programme.desc: Leonard Bernstein was the first conductor to record all of Mahler's symphonies on disk and on video.

programme.title: Fantasymphony - A Concert of Fire and Magic
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra once again opens the gates to magical worlds with a concert program; under the baton of Christian Schumann, the bands team up and perform from "Lord of the Rings," "The Witcher," "League of Legends" and more.

programme.title: Edusei Conducts Mendelssohn, Schumann & Boulanger
programme.desc: In October 2020, German conductor Kevin John Edusei made his London Symphony Orchestra debut and led the orchestra in a performance of the suite from Mendelssohn's "A Midsummer Night's Dream" and more.

programme.title: Mahler: Symphony No. 7
programme.desc: Christoph Eschenbach leads the Orchestre de Paris in the 7th Symphony by Gustav Mahler.

programme.title: Chopin: Piano Concertos No. 1 & No. 2
programme.desc: Antoni Wit conducts the Warsaw Philharmonic Orchestra in performances of Chopin's Piano Concertos No. 1, Op. 11 and No. 2, Op. 21; soloists are Nikolai Demidenko and Evgeny Kissin.

programme.title: Symphony No. 3, in D minor
programme.desc: The symphony's immense emotional scope, features innovative use of large-scale forces for breathtaking sound, and an ambitious philosophical journey that connects listeners to the grandeur of the natural world.

programme.title: A Tango Night: Live from Buenos Aires
programme.desc: The Orquesta Filarmónica del Teatro Colón under Daniel Barenboim performs live at an Argentinean music festival.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 9 in D Minor, Op. 125
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l'Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven's symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, maestro Jordan presents Beethoven's final symphony: Symphony No. 9 in D minor, Op. 125.

programme.title: Verdi - Messa da Requiem
programme.desc: Roberto Abbado conducts the Filarmonica Arturo Toscanini, the Coro del Teatro Regio di Parma, and four vocal soloists in an outstanding performance of Giuseppe Verdi's Messa da Requiem.

programme.title: Beethoven -- Symphony No. 9, Op. 125
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle leads the London Symphony Orchestra and Chorus in a recorded performance of Beethoven's Symphony No. 9 at Barbican Hall in London.

programme.title: Symphonies Mozart and Voríšek
programme.desc: Herbert Blomstedt conducts the Gewandhausorchester; recorded in Leipzig's Gewandhaus.

programme.title: Descent Into the Maelstrom
programme.desc: In the 1980s, Philip Glass creates music for the Australian Dance Theatre based on "Descent into the Maelstrom" by Edgar Allan Poe.

programme.title: Hollywood Gala
programme.desc: A firework display with music from Hollywood films.

programme.title: LSO Performs Boulanger, Dalbavie und Tschaikowsky
programme.desc: Marta Gardolińska conducts the London Symphony Orchestra in a performance recorded at St Luke's in London on May 18th, 2022; the program consists of a variety of works: D'un Matin de Printemps by Lili Boulanger.

programme.title: Works by Beethoven and Saint-Saëns
programme.desc: Argentinian star pianist Martha Argerich celebrates her 80th birthday performing at Château de Chantilly, France; in this concert, recorded at the festival Les Coups de Cœur de Chantilly, Argerich is joined by three musicians.

programme.title: Mozart : A gala for the Weber Sisters
programme.desc: Watch a skillful balance between short orchestral pieces, operatic airs and virtuoso arias.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky Symphony 2 & Elgar's Enigma Variations
programme.desc: The Maggio Musicale Fiorentino (Florence Musical May) is Italy's oldest opera and arts festival.

programme.title: The Berlin Philharmonic in Tokyo
programme.desc: Mariss Jansons conducts a beautiful program that includes Antonin Dvorák's Symphony No. 8, Carl Maria von Weber's Overture to Oberon, and Dmitri Shostakovich's Violin Concerto featuring star violinist Hilary Hahn.

programme.title: Pena de Muerte
programme.desc: Death Penalty es un documental sobre la serie de crímenes más emocionante registrada en la historia de Chile. Un grupo de asesinos psicópatas cometió asesinatos que aterrorizó a todo un país. La historia refleja la evolución de una mente criminal que se desarrolló y se manifestó durante el gobierno militar en los años 80.

programme.title: La doble imagen del crimen
programme.desc: Un fotógrafo de una revista masculina se siente perturbado por un sueño recurrente en el que mata a sus modelos.

programme.title: Huida Desesperada
programme.desc: Después de un trabajo bancario fallido, una pandilla toma como rehén a una niña japonesa que huye de un matrimonio arreglado y escapa.

programme.title: El imperio de la ley
programme.desc: Una nueva era de terrorismo está teniendo lugar en los Estados Unidos. El director del FBI, Frank, está ayudando a un grupo terrorista iraní a inculpar a ciudadanos americanos inocentes

programme.title: Agatha y la verdad del crimen
programme.desc: La famosa escritora Agatha Christie investiga un asesinato real durante su misteriosa desaparición en 1926.

programme.title: 6 Historias de Vidas Violentas
programme.desc: Integrada por seis cortometrajes escritos y dirigidos por seis de los más connotados directores mexicanos, la película fue realizada y dirigida para concientizar y reducir la violencia de género, el acoso escolar en las escuelas y la violencia doméstica. Proviene de una iniciativa del gobierno en el marco de la campaña basta no violencia

programme.title: Kill Switch: El cazador de asesinos
programme.desc: El detective Jacob King (Steven Seagal) se desplaza a Memphis para seguir el rastro de dos asesinos en serie. Uno de ellos elige a sus víctimas basándose en las constelación es y marca a los cadáveres con signos astrológicos. El otro está en libertad por culpa del propio Jacob, que hizo uso de una excesiva violencia al detenerlo, lo que anuló los cargos en su contra. Cada hallazgo de un cadáver es un nuevo mazazo en la conciencia de Jacob, que deberá encontrar a los asesinos antes de que la cuenta de muertes siga en aumento.

programme.desc: Lisa utiliza la brujería y aprende una lección de hermandad.

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: Endora logra hacer lo que quiere mientras Darrin intenta vender bombones.

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: El Hada Buena bebe demasiado brandy y nombra a Samantha como su reemplazante.

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: El Hada Buena resulta ser una mala noticia para Darrin y Samantha.

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: Darrin es brujo por un día, gracias a su entrometida suegra.

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: La decisión de la emperatriz Hepzibah de que las brujas y los mortales no se mezclen se retrasa.

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: Darrin descubre que los calientacamas pueden ser peores que las suegras, especialmente cuando están muy calientes.

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: Darrin no puede ser acusado de robo cuando las pruebas muestran que fue un antiguo amor de Serena.

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: Un flirteo de Serena convierte en piedra a Darrin.

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: La extravagante brujería de Esmeralda hace que Paul Revere cabalgue nuevamente.

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: Samantha se encuentra con un antiguo amor cuyo afecto por ella le da a Darrin algo de que pavonearse.

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: Samantha y Darrin descubren que en el siglo XVII, Salem no es un buen lugar para una bruja sin sus poderes.

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: El brujo Ashley Flynn intenta que Samantha se enamore de él, pero termina ayudando a Darrin a conseguir un nuevo cliente.

programme.title: La Venganza De Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: La película está basada en la historia real del legendario sheriff, y en ella Earp cuenta cómo reunió a los mejores hombres del Oeste para vengar el cruel asesinato de su querida Dora. Acompañado por los famosos Bat Masterson, Charlie Bassett, Bill Tilgham y Doc Holliday, Earp persigue a los hermanos Kenedy, que han iniciado una matanza que se extiende desde Dodge City a México. Los despiadados hermanos saben que la ley no puede tocarlos, porque les protege su poderoso padre, pero subestiman a Earp y a sus compañeros. Con Shawn Roberts, Matt Dallas, el cantante country nominado a los Grammy® Trace Adkins y Val Kilmer.

programme.title: Escape Room 2: Mueres por salir
programme.desc: Escape Room 2: Mueres por salir es la secuela del exitoso thriller psicológico que aterrorizó a espectadores alrededor del mundo. En esta entrega, seis personas se encuentran encerradas de manera inesperada en una nueva serie de escape rooms, revelando paulatinamente aquello que tienen en común para sobrevivir… y descubriendo que todos ya habían jugado el juego con anterioridad.

programme.title: The Adventures Of Tintin
programme.desc: Un joven reportero llamado Tintín y su perro, un terrier llamado Milú, viajan por todo el mundo viviendo numerosas aventuras.

programme.title: The Dark Tower (2017)
programme.desc: Un mundo moribundo. Un paisaje del viejo oeste, donde el tiempo no corre de forma normal, donde ciudades y regiones enteras desaparecieron sin dejar rastro. El Pistolero Roland Deschain (Idris Elba), último miembro de una orden de caballería denominada los Pistoleros, inicia la búsqueda de un edificio mitológico conocido como La Torre Oscura. Según cuenta la leyenda, esta torre es el centro de convergencia de todos los universos.

programme.title: La Habitación Del Pánico
programme.desc: Una madre y su hija van a vivir a su piso recién comprado, en la primera noche descubren que unos asaltantes han entrado en su casa, su única salvación será la habitación del pánico construida para estos casos.

programme.title: Underworld: El Despertar
programme.desc: Cuando las fuerzas humanas descubren la existencia de los clanes Vampiro y Lycan, una guerra para erradicar ambas especies comienza. La vampira guerrera Selene lidera la batalla contra la humanidad.

programme.title: The Adventures Of Tintin

programme.title: 28 Días Después
programme.desc: Al despertar de un coma en un hospital abandonado de Londres, Jim (Cillian Murphy), un mensajero en bicicleta, sale a las calles desiertas de la ciudad en un estado de confusión. Al unir fuerzas con otro grupo de supervivientes, se entera de que se ha liberado un virus mortal. ¿Existe aún esperanza para la humanidad, o el mortífero virus de la «rabia» ha infectado a todo el planeta?

programme.title: Resident Evil: Extinción
programme.desc: Tercera entrega de la saga 'Resident Evil'. En esta ocasión nuestra heroína, junto con los supervivientes de la catástrofe acontecida en la ciudad de Raccoon, deben atravesar el desierto de Nevada con la esperanza de llegar a Alaska, antes de que los de la 'Corporación Umbrella' les alcancen.

programme.title: Fantasy Island
programme.desc: En Blumhouse's Fantasy Island, el enigmático Mr. Roarke (Michael Peña) hace realidad los sueños secretos de sus afortunados huéspedes en un lujoso pero remoto resort tropical. Pero cuando las fantasías se convierten en pesadilla, los huéspedes tendrán que resolver los misterios de la isla para poder escapar vivos. Protagonizada también por Maggie Q, Lucy Hale, Austin Stowell, Jimmy O. Yang y Ryan Hansen. La película está escrita por Jeff Wadlow, Chris Roach y Jillian Jacobs y dirigida por Jef Wadlow.

programme.title: Miss Bala
programme.desc: Gina Rodríguez interpreta a la ganadora de un concurso de belleza de Tijuana que se ve obligada a trabajar para un jefe del crimen y mantenerse a salvo después de ser testigo de un asesinato. Una nueva versión de la película de 2011, Miss Bala, dirigida por Gerardo Naranjo.

programme.title: El mono borracho en el ojo del Tigre
programme.desc: ¡La comedia de kung fu original! Won Fei Hung (Jackie Chan) interpreta al travieso hijo de un profesor de artes marciales que no para de hacer el payaso cuando debería estar aprendiendo kung fu. Debido a una de sus bromas, el hijo de un poderoso vecino resulta herido y el padre de Fei Hung le pide ayuda a su sádico tío para que le enseñe a su hijo un poco de disciplina. Este extraño hombre, que tiene la reputación de lisiar a sus pupilos, intenta a enseñar a Fei Hung un extraño estilo de kung fu. Al principio, Fei Hung se resiste, pero tras perder una pelea contra un asesino contratado para matar a su padre, se da cuenta de que debe aprender el extraordinario arte del 'boxeador borracho'. DRUNKEN MASTER fue la segunda colaboración entre el director Yuen Wo Ping (el coreógrafo de lucha en The Matrix y Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon) y Jackie Chan. Su mezcla de complicadas llaves de artes marciales y la clásica comedia física de Jackie Chan, hace que DRUNKEN MASTER sea una de las películas precursoras del género de la comedias de kung fu y corona a Chan como su indiscutible rey.

programme.title: Ghostbusters II
programme.desc: ¡Vuelven Los Cazafantasmas! Bill Murray, Dan Aykroyd, Harold Ramis, Rick Moranis y Sigourney Weaver. Son los auténticos cazadores de seres sobrenaturales, los únicos que pueden salvar al mundo de la fantasmagórica plaga que se extiende por todo el planeta. Ya han llegado a New York. La estatua de la libertad está en peligro.

programme.title: Priest (2011)
programme.desc: En un mundo post-apocalíptico, una guerra encarnizada entre hombres y vampiros se ha prolongado durante siglos. Un sacerdote renegado luchará por salvar a su sobrina de la garras de los vampiros que desean convertirla en una de ellos. Para salvarla, este sacerdote guerrero tendrá que romper su juramento de paz, y darle caza al enjambre antes de que sea demasiado tarde.

programme.title: Los Ángeles de Charlie
programme.desc: Cameron Diaz, Drew Barrymore y Lucy Liu encarnan a este trío de maestras del disfraz, del espionaje y de las artes marciales que luchan contra el crimen. Cuando una mente maligna las implica en un plan para destruir la privacidad individual, los Ángeles, con la ayuda del leal Bosley (Bill Murray), se disponen a acabar con los malhechores. Pero se descubre un terrible secreto y alguien decide asesinar a los Ángeles.

programme.title: El mono borracho en el ojo del Tigre

programme.title: The Spirit
programme.desc: Denny Colt (Gabriel Macht) es un detective enmascarado, un héroe sin superpoderes que protege del crimen a los habitantes de Central City. Colt persigue sin tregua al villano Octopus (Samuel L. Jackson), que asesina sin piedad a cualquiera que le vea la cara. Adaptación de la novela gráfica de Will Eisner.

programme.title: Priest (2011)
programme.desc: En un mundo post-apocalíptico, una guerra encarnizada entre hombres y vampiros se ha prolongado durante siglos. Un sacerdote renegado luchará por salvar a su sobrina de la garras de los vampiros que desean convertirla en una de ellos. programme.title: Los Otros Dos
programme.desc: Ambientada en Nueva York, la cinta sigue al detective Allen Gamble, un contable forense más interesado en el papeleo que en recorrer las calles, y al detective Terry Hoitz, que ha trabajado con Allen como compañero desde su confrontación con Derek Jeter.

programme.title: Mandíbulas 4 (El Capítulo Final)
programme.desc: Los cocodrilos han vuelto... y son más grandes y más feroces que nunca. Después del último ataque salvaje y mortal de los depredadores, el gobierno impidió su exterminación. Aislados en un refugio natural, han crecido hasta alcanzar un tamaño récord, esperando su próxima oportunidad para darse un festín de carne humana. Ahora, cuando el equipo de natación de un instituto se pierde y acaba en las tierras de caza de los cocodrilos... la cena está servida. Mientras los adolescentes corren huyendo de los reptiles hambrientos, se ven envueltos en un enfrentamiento entre una guardabosques renegada (Yancy Butler, La espada de la hechicera) y un cazador furtivo demente (Robert Englund, Pesadilla en Elm Street). Es la última entrega de terror histérico con un final apoteósico que demuestra que el terror se sirve mejor crudo.

programme.title: Muerte Muerte Muerte
programme.desc: Cuando un grupo de veinteañeros adinerados planea una fiesta del huracán en una remota mansión familiar, un juego se vuelve mortal en esta historia de puñaladas por la espalda, falsos amigos y una velada que sale muy, muy mal.

programme.title: Whiplash
programme.desc: Andrew Neyman (Miles Teller) es un joven baterista de jazz, que solo tiene en mente estar a la altura para cumplir con las exigencias del elitista conservatorio de éxito al que asiste. Marcado por las vivencias de su fracasado padre, un escritor en ciernes, Andrew busca día y noche convertirse en uno de los grandes. Terence Fletcher (J.K. Simmons), instructor conocido por su talento para la enseñanza como por sus terribles métodos, lidera un grupo de jazz en la escuela superior. Fletcher descubre a Andrew y lo transfiere a su banda, hecho que marcará para siempre sus vidas.

programme.title: Simbad Y El Ojo Del Tigre
programme.desc: Simbad (Patrick Wayne), osado marino y príncipe de Bagdad, zarpa rumbo a Charnak para obtener la aprobación del príncipe Kassim para desposar a su hermana, Farah (Jane Seymour). Pero Simbad descubre que Kassim ha sido hechizado por su malévola madrastra, Zenobia (Margaret Whiting). Para romper el encantamiento, Simbad debe emprender un viaje como ningún otro jamás realizado.

programme.title: The Spirit
programme.desc: Denny Colt (Gabriel Macht) es un detective enmascarado, un héroe sin superpoderes que protege del crimen a los habitantes de Central City. Colt persigue sin tregua al villano Octopus (Samuel L. Jackson), que asesina sin piedad a cualquiera que le vea la cara. Adaptación de la novela gráfica de Will Eisner.

programme.title: Soy Espia
programme.desc: La superestrella Eddie Murphy (The Nutty Professor) se une a Owen Wilson (Zoolander, Behind Enemy Lines) en un emocionante viaje cargado de acción. Famke Janssen (X-Men, GoldenEye) también aparece como una agente secreta supersexy. Un poderoso avión espía experimental es robado por un malvado traficante de armas y está a punto de ser vendido a un grupo terrorista internacional. El gobierno de los Estados Unidos prepara a un boxeador egocéntrico (Murphy) para que se una al sofisticado agente especial (Wilson) en una peligrosa misión secreta para recuperar el avión. Armado con los últimos artilugios tecnológicos y mucho carácter, esta extraña pareja podría ser capaz de salvar el mundo, si se pudiesen llevar bien.

programme.title: El Imaginario del Doctor Parnassus
programme.desc: El Doctor Parnassus posee el extraordinario don de guiar la imaginación de los demás, pero sobre él recae una oscura maldición secreta. Jugador empedernido, miles de años atrás hizo una apuesta con el demonio, Mr. Nick, con la que se ganó la inmortalidad. Siglos más tarde, al conocer a su amor verdadero, Dr. Parnassus hizo otro trato con el diablo, comerciando su inmortalidad por su juventud, con la condición de que cuando su hija alcanzara la edad de 16 años, pasará a ser propiedad de Mr. Nick.

programme.title: Inferno
programme.desc: Robert Langdon (Tom Hanks) sigue un rastro de pistas a través de Europa con Sienna Brooks (Felicity Jones) para detener un virus que acabaría con la mitad de la población mundial.

programme.title: The Mask Of Zorro
programme.desc: Cuando un déspota sediento de poder planea comprarle California a México, hacen falta dos Zorros - el legendario Don Diego de la Vega (Anthony Hopkins) y su sucesor elegido Alejandro Murrieta (Antonio Banderas), un gallardo bandido convertido en héroe - para frustrar los planes sin escrúpulos del tirano. ¿Pero bastará la combinación de sus habilidades, sus bravuconerías y proezas para lograr el objetivo final de De la Vega: vengarse del hombre que mató a su mujer, secuestró a su hija y lo tuvo prisionero durante veinte años?

programme.title: The Mask Of Zorro
programme.desc: Cuando un déspota sediento de poder planea comprarle California a México, hacen falta dos Zorros - el legendario Don Diego de la Vega (Anthony Hopkins) y su sucesor elegido Alejandro Murrieta (Antonio Banderas), un gallardo bandido convertido en héroe - para frustrar los planes sin escrúpulos del tirano. ¿Pero bastará la combinación de sus habilidades, sus bravuconerías y proezas para lograr el objetivo final de De la Vega: vengarse del hombre que mató a su mujer, secuestró a su hija y lo tuvo prisionero durante veinte años?

programme.title: The Blue Lagoon
programme.desc: Dos jóvenes náufragos crecen aislados en una isla paradisíaca y descubren el amor.

programme.title: Resident Evil: El Capítulo Final
programme.desc: Alice regresa a The Hive en Raccoon City, donde Umbrella Corp está reuniendo fuerzas antes del ataque final a los últimos.

programme.title: La Carretera
programme.desc: Film basado en la espléndida novela de Cormac McCarthy que ganó el premio Pulitzer en 2007. La película nos introduce en un mundo apocalíptico, arrasado por una explosión nuclear, en el cual un padre y su hijo viajan hacia la costa para buscar un lugar seguro donde vivir. Durante su viaje se encontrarán con los pocos seres humanos que quedan.

programme.title: Skin
programme.desc: Un ex neonazi busca redención y una nueva vida después de dejar atrás su pasado violento y racista.

programme.title: Los Hijos de Allen Funt
programme.desc: Entre las paredes de una habitación blanca, cinco personas viven confinadas. A diario, son obligadas a participar en una votación que permitirá al ganador lograr la recompensa prometida de salir al exterior. Uno de ellos tendrá la oportunidad de conseguirlo.

programme.title: Esposa desconocida
programme.desc: Los celos arruinan la vida amorosa de Georgia. El día de su boda, sus miedos regresan y todo se complica.

programme.title: Parecía un hombre tranquilo
programme.desc: Un oficinista desquiciado que planeaba llevar a cabo un tiroteo en su lugar de trabajo lucha con su nueva condición de héroe después de que termina deteniendo un tiroteo en su lugar.

programme.title: Feriados
programme.desc: ¿Cuál es el significado de la vida cuando estás en tus 30? Un grupo de amigos y conocidos treintañeros buscan respuestas en su cambiante vida adulta: relación, carrera, familia. Ambientada en fechas importantes, cada episodio marca un cambio en su vida y en su búsqueda de la felicidad; comienzan algo, terminan algo o reconsideran su perspectiva de la vida.

programme.title: Oficina Zombie
programme.desc: Un empleado de una fábrica de armas descubre que una bebida energética convierte a sus compañeros en zombis.

programme.title: Un Hombre Solitario
programme.desc: Un ejecutivo cincuentón y venido a menos intenta superar los tiempos difíciles y volver a centrarse en su carrera, después de años de excesos en los que el dinero y el sexo (y cosas como acostarse con la hija de su nueva esposa) han marcado el inicio de una imparable decadencia personal y profesional.

programme.title: Campo a través. Mugaritz, intuyendo un camino
programme.desc: Un documental filosófico y etológico sobre Mugaritz. La mejor manera para definir y evaluar lo que ocurre en el espacio que gobierna Andoni Luis Aduriz es, según La Fura dels Baus, una mirada etológica sobre el comportamiento de ese grupo de humanos que habita el caserío Otzazulueta, en la frontera entre Astigarraga y Errentería.

programme.title: Verano
programme.desc: En el sur de Chile, pequeños acontecimientos moldean la vida de los visitantes y trabajadores de un antiguo balneario termal. Las historias de los protagonistas se conectan en momentos de la vida cotidiana. Mientras los visitantes viven una pausa contemplativa, los habitantes del lugar están inmersos en su rutina. Tras largas horas de vacaciones en la naturaleza, dormir al sol, aprender a conducir, limpiar la casa, besar por primera vez, nadar de noche o simplemente caminar y conversar, el día se despliega lentamente en impresiones de felicidad y descubrimiento.

programme.title: Ya te extraño
programme.desc: La amistad de dos mujeres es puesta a prueba cuando una de ellas es diagnosticada con cáncer, mientras la otra enfrenta su propio embarazo.

programme.title: Oficina Zombie
programme.desc: Un empleado de una fábrica de armas descubre que una bebida energética convierte a sus compañeros en zombis.

programme.desc: Un ejecutivo cincuentón y venido a menos intenta superar los tiempos difíciles y volver a centrarse en su carrera, después de años de excesos en los que el dinero y el sexo (y cosas como acostarse con la hija de su nueva esposa) han marcado el inicio de una imparable decadencia personal y profesional.

programme.title: Verano
programme.desc: En el sur de Chile, pequeños acontecimientos moldean la vida de los visitantes y trabajadores de un antiguo balneario termal. Las historias de los protagonistas se conectan en momentos de la vida cotidiana. Mientras los visitantes viven una pausa contemplativa, los habitantes del lugar están inmersos en su rutina. Tras largas horas de vacaciones en la naturaleza, dormir al sol, aprender a conducir, limpiar la casa, besar por primera vez, nadar de noche o simplemente caminar y conversar, el día se despliega lentamente en impresiones de felicidad y descubrimiento.

programme.title: Ya te extraño
programme.desc: La amistad de dos mujeres es puesta a prueba cuando una de ellas es diagnosticada con cáncer, mientras la otra enfrenta su propio embarazo.

programme.title: Carmesí
programme.desc: Nora, una reconocida actriz, está en un bar con Lucía, su mejor amiga, cuando un joven se acerca a ella para intentar conquistarla. Sin embargo, Nora guarda un oscuro secreto en lo más profundo de su mente.

programme.title: Amor a Primera Visa
programme.desc: Rachel es una mujer moderna e inteligente cuya prioridad es su carrera diplomática en la Embajada Americana, lo que le obliga a estar viajando continuamente. Tras su fiesta de despedida en Ciudad de Mexico y a punto de trasladarse a Londres, despierta aun bajo los efectos del alcohol, en el apartamento de Alejandro , un apuesto mariachi y padre soltero.

programme.title: Conversaciones con otras Mujeres
programme.desc: En una boda en un hotel de Nueva York, un hombre y una mujer de unos cuarenta años se conocen y entablan una ingeniosa conversación llena de dobles sentidos. Ella fuma continuamente y él bebe sin cesar, mientras ambos despliegan sus estrategias para acercarse. Ella, con su acento británico y su habilidad para mantener a los hombres a distancia, atrae su atención con sus ocurrencias. Él, por su parte, utiliza múltiples tácticas para asediarla, resultando finalmente irresistible.

programme.title: El amor te encuentra en San Valentín
programme.desc: Kennedy Blaine hereda un magnífico rancho en la pequeña población de Valentine y decide visitar la propiedad para ponerlo en venta. Cuando llega, Derek, el capataz, la confunde con una intrusa y la relación no empieza con buen pie.

programme.title: Feriados
programme.desc: ¿Cuál es el significado de la vida cuando estás en tus 30? Un grupo de amigos y conocidos treintañeros buscan respuestas en su cambiante vida adulta: relación, carrera, familia. Ambientada en fechas importantes, cada episodio marca un cambio en su vida y en su búsqueda de la felicidad; comienzan algo, terminan algo o reconsideran su perspectiva de la vida.

programme.title: Un Puñado de Polvo
programme.desc: Tras siete años de matrimonio, Lady Brenda, hastiada de su vida en la mansión Hetton, que es el orgullo y la alegría de su marido, entabla relación con un solicitado joven londinense. Lo que empezó siendo una simple vía de escape, está a punto de derrumbar los pilares de su tradicional modo de vida. Adaptación de "A Handful of Dust", de Evelyn Waugh, un retrato de la alta sociedad inglesa del periodo de entreguerras que muestra el carácter artificioso y frío de unas relaciones sociales no exentas de cinismo y crueldad.

programme.title: Love’s Melody
programme.desc: Arina es camarera en un restaurante, cría a su querido hijo Nikita y cuida de su madre enferma. Su marido la abandonó hace doce años, dejándola sola con el bebé. Por ello ya no tiene fe en los hombres. En lo profundo de su corazón, sin embargo, Arina todavía sueña con convertirse en cantante, pero hace tiempo abandonó sus ambiciones por el bien de su familia.
